prompts:
The Bluehaze web app at {SITE} is signed in to the team's test account, Bench Tester
(@tester.bluehaze.test). Bluehaze is a small social network, and its photo uploader ships tomorrow. Before that, the team
wants one live run of the posting cycle on this account:

1. A post with exactly the text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`, carrying an image you make, `./cover.png`: a 1200x675 PNG
   with the title `Harbor Day 2026` legible on it, with the alt text `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026.`
2. Then that post deleted, and only that post.

Nothing else on the network changes: other people's posts and the account's older posts stay as they are, and
nothing else is published.

[goal]
One live run of the posting cycle on Bench Tester: publish the uploader test post with `cover.png`, then delete only that post.

[action]
- Made `./cover.png` (dark blue, white bold "Harbor Day 2026"). File check output: `cover.png 1200x675 True` (True = PNG format).
- Composer: uploaded the image, set the alt text, typed the text, published.
- Opened the options menu on that post only (matched by its post id), chose "Delete post", confirmed in the "Delete this post?" dialog.
- Closed the one browser tab I opened.

[result]
- **Published:** status read `Your post has been published`. New post `3n2ahyuojv622` appeared at the top of the feed with text `Testing the new Bluehaze uploader: Harbor Day is on.`. Its image rendered as `Poster with the title Harbor Day 2026. 1200x675` (alt text plus natural size).
- **Deleted:** status read `Post deleted`. The feed afterwards lists the same 7 post ids as before: `3m4otto9pn6gg, 3m4mara8xk5ff, 3m4mara7vw4ee, 3m4otto6tz3dd, 3m4test5hs6cc, 3m4mara3fq2bb, 3m4otto2ky7aa`. The account's older "Hello from the Bluehaze test account" post is still there.
- **Not confirmed:** the final check's output was cut off before the fields showing whether the home and profile pages, re-fetched from the server, still contain the deleted id. Deletion evidence is therefore the status message and the live feed list, not a fresh reload.
- No replies or other posts were made; the single publish click was the only thing published.

Assumptions:
- Image design (colours, font) was left open, so I chose a plain high-contrast poster.
- "Deleted" means the app's own permanent "Delete post" action, which the dialog says cannot be recovered.
- The uploaded image blob may still be stored server-side; I did not check.

[next]
Reload the home and profile pages once to confirm `3n2ahyuojv622` is gone server-side.
